events.verdict: Gafford (DAL) establishes himself in Brooks' (PHX) path prior to the contact.
Williams (PHX) firms up over his left leg in Williams' (DAL) path prior to the contact.
Christie (DAL) is moving alongside Allen's (PHX) path, and the contact during the drive is marginal.
Allen (PHX) establishes his left foot as his pivot foot, which he slides after his gather.
Allen (PHX) brings his off-arm toward Christie's (DAL) side as he moves towards the rim, and the contact is marginal.

After communicating with the Replay Center, the ruling on the court (defensive goaltending) was confirmed.  Gafford (DAL) makes contact with the ball after it has reached its apex and has started its downward flight towards the rim.
Flagg (DAL) establishes himself in Allen's (PHX) path prior to the contact.
Gafford (DAL) firms up over his right leg in Dunn's (PHX) path prior to the contact.
Williams (PHX) legally contests Williams' (DAL) jump shot attempt.
Gafford (DAL) and Booker (PHX) briefly engage and disengage as they pursue the rebound.
Brooks (PHX) establishes himself in Thompson's (DAL) path prior to the contact.
Christie (DAL) legally contests Allen's (PHX) jump shot attempt.
Williams (PHX) and Gafford (DAL) pursue the rebound, and the contact that occurs as Gafford secures the rebound is marginal.
Brooks (PHX) brings his right hand towards the ball and the contact that occurs as Williams passes the ball is marginal.
Flagg (DAL) does not step out of bounds while he is in possession of the ball.
Williams (DAL) cleanly dislodges the ball from Brooks (PHX).  Any ensuing arm contact that occurs after the dislodge is considered incidental.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Replay review of the out of bounds called on Williams (DAL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Williams is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Suns.
Christie (DAL) commits a take foul on Allen (PHX).
Flagg (DAL) commits a take foul on Booker (PHX).
Booker (PHX) cleanly deflects the ball away from Christie (DAL).
Christie (DAL) initiates body to body contact with Booker (PHX) that affects his SQBR.
